doc: stages/filters.assign.rst, note under 'Assignment Expressions': 'As of PDAL 2.7.0, assignment to a dimension that does not exist will cause it to be created. It will always be created with type double, however.'  The same page: 'A ``ValueExpression`` consists of constants, dimension names and mathematical operators that evaluates to a numeric value.'  The page names no mathematical function, so `sqrt` is cited from the profile, not the page.  PROFILE.md 7.2: '**`filters.assign` accepts unary maths** in an assignment expression. The page lists only the arithmetic operators, so the accepted function names are named here, because they are what the binary parses and an unknown one is refused outright (`Invalid function name '<name>'`): `floor`, `ceil`, `round`, `abs`, `fabs`, `sqrt`, `sin`, `cos`, `tan`, `asin`, `acos`, `atan`, `sinh`, `cosh`, `tanh`, `asinh`, `acosh`, `log` (natural), `log2`, `log10`, `exp`, `exp2`. They nest, they may read any dimension, and `WHERE` still gates the assignment.'  The fixture's Intensity runs 0..999, so the created dimension holds sqrt of each, a mean of 21.06583311 and a maximum of 31.60696126.
